## Delivery Plan

Link to the plan document in `design/delivery-plans/`.
That document is authoritative for everything below —
this issue exists to hold the milestone sub-issues and show their rollup progress.

## Summary

One or two sentences on what this plan delivers overall.
Don't restate the plan; the document carries the milestone breakdown,
the delivery-risk reasoning, and the record of any resequencing.

## Milestones

Created as sub-issues of this issue, one per milestone in the plan.
Sequencing between them is recorded with issue relationships (`blocked by`),
so that unstarted milestones don't show up as actionable work.

## Additional Context

Anything else worth knowing — related documents, external dependencies, open decisions.

---

Close this issue when its last milestone closes.
